## Fun facts

- **Cristiano Ronaldo** — He has his own museum in Madeira, Portugal called 'Museu CR7' and sleeps in 5 short 90-minute naps a day!
- **Lionel Messi** — His first contract with Barcelona was signed on a paper napkin at a restaurant!
- **Kylian Mbappé** — He donated his entire 2018 World Cup bonus (about $500,000) to a children's charity!
- **Erling Haaland** — He meditates before every match and his dad Alfie also played in the Premier League for Manchester City!
- **Jude Bellingham** — Birmingham City retired his #22 shirt when he was only 17 years old — the youngest player ever to get that honor!
- **Mohamed Salah** — He's known as the 'Egyptian King' and crime rates in Liverpool reportedly dropped when he signed!
- **Lamine Yamal** — He became the youngest ever goalscorer at a European Championship at just 16 years and 362 days old!
- **Neymar** — He was named after his father, who was also a professional footballer, and he can solve a Rubik's cube!
- **Vinícius Júnior** — Real Madrid signed him when he was just 16 for €45 million before he'd even played a full professional season!
- **Harry Kane** — He was released by Arsenal's youth academy as a kid and went on to become Tottenham's all-time top scorer!
- **Pelé** — He scored over 1,000 career goals and once caused a ceasefire in a civil war in Nigeria so both sides could watch him play!
- **Ronaldinho** — He made the entire Santiago Bernabéu (Real Madrid's stadium) give him a standing ovation — as a Barcelona player!
- **David Beckham** — He can bend a ball so well they made a movie about it — 'Bend It Like Beckham'!
- **Zinedine Zidane** — His volley goal in the 2002 Champions League final is considered one of the greatest goals ever scored!
- **Thierry Henry** — He's Arsenal's all-time top scorer with 228 goals and has a statue outside the Emirates Stadium!
- **Zlatan Ibrahimović** — He once said 'I didn't injure myself, I am Zlatan!' and has a black belt in taekwondo!
- **Diego Maradona** — His 'Hand of God' and 'Goal of the Century' both happened in the same World Cup match against England in 1986!
- **Cole Palmer** — He scored 4 goals in a single half against Everton in 2024 — the first Chelsea player ever to do that in the Premier League!
- **Ousmane Dembélé** — He won the 2025 Ballon d'Or after leading PSG to their first-ever Champions League title!
- **Raphinha** — He went from being transfer-listed by Barcelona to their top scorer with 26 goals in the 2024-25 season — one of the greatest turnarounds in club history!
- **Bukayo Saka** — He missed the decisive penalty in the Euro 2020 final at just 19 years old, then bounced back to become one of the best wingers in Europe — a true story of resilience!
- **Florian Wirtz** — He was the heartbeat of the historic 2023-24 Bayer Leverkusen side that went the entire Bundesliga season unbeaten — a feat no German team had ever achieved before!
- **Jack Jewsbury** — He was the first-ever captain of the Portland Timbers in MLS and lifted the 2015 MLS Cup trophy for the city!
- **Diego Valeri** — He scored the fastest goal in MLS Cup history at just 27 seconds and is the Timbers' all-time leading scorer with 86 goals!
- **Darlington Nagbe** — Born in Liberia, he moved to the US as a child and scored one of the greatest goals in Timbers history — a stunning volley from outside the box!
- **Achraf Hakimi** — He plays right-back but scores and assists like a winger — he helped Morocco become the first African team ever to reach a World Cup semifinal in 2022!
- **Alisson Becker** — He's a goalkeeper who once scored a last-minute header to win a game for Liverpool — goalkeepers almost never score!
- **Bernardo Silva** — He's so good at keeping the ball that teammates joke defenders can't take it off him even in a phone booth!
- **Bruno Fernandes** — He's the captain of Manchester United and takes some of the most powerful penalties in the world!
- **Christian Pulisic** — Nicknamed 'Captain America', he became the most expensive American player ever when Chelsea signed him!
- **Dani Carvajal** — He has won the Champions League SIX times — more than almost any player alive — and scored the winning header in a final!
- **Declan Rice** — He captained West Ham to a European trophy, then became one of the most expensive English players ever when Arsenal signed him!
- **Désiré Doué** — As a teenager he scored twice in the 2025 Champions League final to help PSG win the biggest club trophy for the first time!
- **Diego Chará** — He's a Portland Timbers legend who has played more games for the club than almost anyone in team history!
- **Emiliano Martínez** — This goalkeeper made an incredible last-second save to help Argentina win the 2022 World Cup — and loves doing funny celebrations!
- **Federico Valverde** — He can run all game long and shoots the ball so hard that teammates nicknamed him 'El Pajarito' (the little bird) — but his shots fly like rockets!
- **Jamal Musiala** — Nicknamed 'Bambi', he dribbles so smoothly it looks like the ball is glued to his feet!
- **João Félix** — He became one of the most expensive teenagers in football history when Atlético Madrid paid €126 million for him!
- **João Neves** — He's a tiny midfielder with a giant engine — he won the Champions League with PSG when he was still a teenager!
- **Johan Cruyff** — He invented a famous move called the 'Cruyff Turn' that players all over the world still use today!
- **Joshua Kimmich** — He can play almost any position on the field and is famous for never, ever giving up on a play!
- **Kaká** — He was the last player to win the Ballon d'Or before Messi and Ronaldo took over for over a decade!
- **Karim Benzema** — He won the Ballon d'Or in 2022 after scoring loads of last-minute goals to help Real Madrid win the Champions League!
- **Kevin De Bruyne** — He passes the ball so perfectly that many people call him the best passer in the whole world!
- **Luka Modrić** — He won the Ballon d'Or in 2018, breaking a 10-year streak where only Messi and Ronaldo had won it!
- **Luis Suárez** — He's one of Uruguay's greatest goalscorers ever and now plays alongside his best friend Lionel Messi at Inter Miami!
- **Marc Cucurella** — You can spot him instantly on the field because of his big, bouncy curly hair!
- **Marcelo** — He won the Champions League five times and is the most decorated player in Real Madrid's entire history!
- **Martin Ødegaard** — He was so good as a kid that Real Madrid signed him when he was only 15 years old!
- **Michael Olise** — He can curl free kicks and crosses with amazing accuracy — defenders never know what he'll do next!
- **Nadine Angerer** — This legendary goalkeeper saved a penalty in a World Cup final and didn't let in a single goal in the whole 2007 tournament!
- **Nico Williams** — He scored in the Euro 2024 final to help Spain become champions — and his brother Iñaki plays for Ghana!
- **Nuno Mendes** — He's a left-back who is so fast he can sprint past wingers and defend the whole side of the pitch by himself!
- **Patrik Schick** — He scored one of the greatest goals ever at Euro 2020 — a shot from almost the halfway line!
- **Pau Cubarsí** — He became one of Barcelona's most important defenders while still a teenager — super calm and never panics with the ball!
- **Pedri** — He almost never loses the ball — some games he completes 100 passes without a single mistake!
- **Pedro Neto** — He's lightning fast on the wing and helped Chelsea win a big trophy in the summer of 2025!
- **Phil Foden** — He grew up a Manchester City fan and now plays for his favorite club — a real dream come true!
- **Rafael Leão** — As well as football, he loves music and has even released his own rap songs!
- **Robert Lewandowski** — He once scored FIVE goals in just nine minutes — the fastest five goals in football history!
- **Roberto Carlos** — He scored a free kick that curved so much it looked like magic — scientists studied it to figure out how it was possible!
- **Rodri** — He won the 2024 Ballon d'Or as a midfielder — and scored the winning goal in the Champions League final!
- **Ronaldo Nazário (R9)** — Many people call him the greatest striker ever — he came back from serious knee injuries to win the 2002 World Cup!
- **Romelu Lukaku** — He's a giant, powerful striker who speaks six different languages!
- **Son Heung-min** — He can shoot equally well with both his left and right foot, and won the Premier League Golden Boot for most goals!
- **Thibaut Courtois** — He's one of the tallest goalkeepers in football and had a legendary game in the 2022 Champions League final, saving everything!
- **Virgil van Dijk** — He's so good at defending that attackers say it feels impossible to dribble past him!
- **Vitinha** — He was the midfield engine that helped PSG finally win their first Champions League in 2025!
- **Casemiro** — He's a defensive midfielder who guards his team like a wall — and he won the Champions League three times in a row with Real Madrid!
- **Eusébio** — Nicknamed the 'Black Panther', he was one of the fastest and most powerful strikers ever — he was the top scorer of the 1966 World Cup and has a statue outside Benfica's stadium!
- **Franz Beckenbauer** — Nicknamed 'Der Kaiser' (The Emperor), he invented the modern attacking defender role — and he won the World Cup as both a player and a coach!
- **Ferenc Puskás** — He scored an incredible 700+ career goals, and FIFA named its award for the best goal of the year the 'Puskás Award' after him!
- **Luís Figo** — He won the Ballon d'Or in 2000 and made one of the most shocking transfers ever — moving straight from Barcelona to their biggest rivals, Real Madrid!
- **Antonio Rüdiger** — He's a super-strong defender famous for his giant smile — he won the Champions League with Chelsea and now shuts down the world's best strikers for Real Madrid!
- **Petr Čech** — He wore a special head guard to protect him after an injury, and he holds the record for the most clean sheets (games without letting in a goal) in Premier League history!
- **Cafu** — He's the only player ever to play in three World Cup finals in a row (1994, 1998, 2002) — and he captained Brazil to the trophy in 2002!
- **Pepe** — One of the toughest defenders ever, he kept playing at the very top into his 40s — he became the oldest outfield player in European Championship history at age 41!
- **Alejandro Garnacho** — He scored a jaw-dropping bicycle-kick goal against Everton — one of the most spectacular goals of the whole season!
- **David De Gea** — He is famous for making super-fast saves with his feet and legs, and he once made 14 saves in a single Premier League game — a record!
- **Harry Maguire** — He is a big, strong centre-back who is great at heading the ball — he scored important headers for England at the 2018 World Cup, where the team finished 4th!
- **Paolo Maldini** — He played his whole career — over 900 games and 25 years — for just one club, AC Milan, and won the Champions League 5 times!
- **Sergio Ramos** — He is a defender who scores tons of goals with his head — including a last-minute equaliser in a Champions League final that Real Madrid went on to win!
- **Manuel Neuer** — He is famous as a "sweeper-keeper" who runs far out of his goal to kick the ball like an extra defender — and he won the 2014 World Cup with Germany!
- **Iker Casillas** — He was the captain and goalkeeper when Spain won the 2010 World Cup, and he made a famous toe save in the final to keep the score 0-0!
- **Gabriel Jesus** — Before he was famous, he helped paint the streets of his neighborhood in Brazil to celebrate the World Cup — and then grew up to play in it for Brazil!
- **Alphonso Davies** — Nicknamed the "Roadrunner," he is one of the fastest players in the world — he was born in a refugee camp and grew up to become Canada's biggest soccer star!
